body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Optoma unveiled ''DV11'' its new portable all-in-one home entertainment projector during CES 2007. The DV11, the successor to ‘DV10 (also known as Movie Time)’, features DVD player and two 5W built-in speakers. It offers 1300 ANSI lumen of brightness and 3000:1 contrast ratio.
It is expected to be available in Q1, 2007 for 999(USD).
